TABLE.NAME: local_miwlab_restores
TABLE.COMMENT: Progress of the restores queued by the MiwLab. No data of a person.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The new course, once created; the course replaced, in mode replace

FIELD.NAME: mode
FIELD.COMMENT: new: a new course in the category; replace: the content of courseid replaced (1.5.0)

FIELD.NAME: marker
FIELD.COMMENT: MiwLab marker to write in the course ID number

FIELD.NAME: backupfilename
FIELD.COMMENT: Mode replace: the backup made before, in the course backup area

FIELD.NAME: rolledback
FIELD.COMMENT: Mode replace: the restore failed after deleting content and the backup was restored

FIELD.NAME: expectedsignature
FIELD.COMMENT: Mode replace: the state of the course the MiwLab knew, checked again before replacing

FIELD.NAME: unchangedsince
FIELD.COMMENT: Mode replace: without the state, the course must not have been edited after this time

FIELD.NAME: topicscreated
FIELD.COMMENT: 1.7.0: forum topics recreated from the package after the restore

FIELD.NAME: topicsskipped
FIELD.COMMENT: 1.7.0: forum topics of the package that could not be created

FIELD.NAME: topicsnote
FIELD.COMMENT: 1.7.0: the first reason a topic was not created

TABLE.NAME: local_miwlab_backups
TABLE.COMMENT: Content backups of courses made for the MiwLab (1.6.0), without any data of a person; the file is deleted once downloaded or after a day.

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: The backup file, in the course context, area contentbackup, item = id

FIELD.NAME: secrethash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the secret returned once to the request that queued the backup; status, parts and deletion need it
